queries.query: Selecting an adsorption medium for a defined PFAS water-treatment application. Prepare a focused, data-grounded review explaining how an engineer should select an adsorption medium for a specified PFAS profile and water matrix.
Compare the adsorption mechanisms and material properties most relevant to PFAS chain length, functional group, and precursor composition.
Evaluate how dissolved organic matter, inorganic ions, pH, competing contaminants, and influent concentration alter performance.
Translate the evidence into conditional media-selection criteria rather than a universal material ranking.
